title: Rey
description: Rey grew up alone, living as a scavenger. Escaping Jakku with BB-8 and Finn aboard the Millennium Falcon, Rey found herself in the middle of the war between the Resistance and the First Order. Maz Kanata gave her Luke Skywalker's last Lightsaber, and Rey fought Kylo Ren. Rey later found Luke in an effort to bring him back to the Resistance.
